Name: Cherry Lake Tilesheet
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
New outdoor tilesheet featuring seasonal fences, buildings, bushes for all your mapping needs… and hopefully delight! Support [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url].

[line]

This tilesheet is something I made for my own project called Cherry Lake Town. It's been in the works for quite a while now, but there's still a long way to go. I'm not planning to release the mod though, but maybe you'll catch glimpses of it in my mod preview posts. Anyway releasing the custom assets I made for it as tilesheet mod is something I've wanted to do for a long time, and now here it is. I hope people found a use for it.

And for those of you wondering: Yes, I'm still working on the Victorian Furniture mod!


For Modmakers:
* Modders are free to use this tilesheet mod, but it must be listed as a requirement.
* Do not include this mod's .png files in your upload.
* If you want to customize any of the assets for a more personal touch, feel free to copy the specific asset into your own tilesheet and edit it there. Keep in mind that you'll still need to use this mod as a requirement, and don't forget to give credit!

Happy modding!
